note: Filed 5 Aug 2026 by the satellite-verification build (ingest/satellite.py). Mireye already serves Sentinel-2 NDVI as ndvi_current and ndvi_change_5y; this asks for the three things those fields cannot do — caller-selected dates, footprint aggregation, and scene metadata (id, acquisition datetime, cloud fraction). /v1/ask was tried first at 35.065,-90.075 and refused; the refusal is quoted verbatim in the description.

disposition.ask: NDVI averaged over a caller-supplied radius (default 500 m) on a caller-supplied date, with scene id, acquisition datetime, and cloud fraction
disposition.reason: ndvi_current and ndvi_change_5y exist but neither supports caller-selectable dates, radius-averaging, or scene metadata (acquisition datetime, cloud fraction, scene id). This is a time-series imagery query that requires temporal selectivity and footprint aggregation not present in the catalog.

disposition.ask: Delta NDVI: mean NDVI on date B minus mean NDVI on date A, averaged over a caller-supplied radius
disposition.reason: ndvi_change_5y is a fixed 5-year window; it does not answer a caller-selected pair of dates. This would require temporal selectivity to pairs of dates chosen by the requester.

disposition.ask: Fraction of the footprint that transitioned from vegetated (NDVI >= 0.30) to bare (NDVI < 0.20) between two dates
disposition.reason: No candidate field measures vegetation-loss transition classes at a threshold-based level over a caller-specified radius and date pair. This would require binned NDVI classification and multi-date aggregation.
